```{python}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
import sqlite3
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.io as pio

pio.templates.default = "plotly_white"

# Connect to persistent local SQLite store
conn = sqlite3.connect("data/processed/providence_health_equity.db")

df = pd.read_sql("""
    SELECT 
        geo_id, geo_name, geo_type, icd10_category, visit_count, total_charges,
        total_population, group_quarters_population, community_population,
        raw_rate_per_1k, adjusted_rate_per_1k
    FROM normalized_health_equity
""", conn)
conn.close()
```

## Row {height=80%}

### Column {width=60%}

```{python}
#| title: "Preventable ED Visit Rate per 1,000 Residents Across Health Equity Zones"
df_hez = df[df['geo_type'] == 'HEZ'].groupby(['geo_name', 'icd10_category'])['adjusted_rate_per_1k'].mean().reset_index()

fig = px.bar(
    df_hez,
    x="geo_name",
    y="adjusted_rate_per_1k",
    color="icd10_category",
    labels={"adjusted_rate_per_1k": "Visits per 1,000 Residents", "geo_name": "Health Equity Zone"},
    color_discrete_sequence=["#0A2540", "#007A87", "#D97706", "#64748B"]
)
fig.update_layout(margin=dict(l=20, r=20, t=20, b=20))
fig
```

### Column {width=40%}

::: {.card title="Key Policy Insights"}
* **Safety-Net Overcrowding:** High-frequency emergency department visits for low-acuity conditions (primary dental pain, uncontrolled asthma) remain concentrated in urban safety-net corridors (`02907` South Providence and `02909` Olneyville).
* **Student Denominator Distortion:** In `02906` (College Hill/East Side), including 10,200 university dorm residents in the Census denominator artificially suppresses the apparent rate by **35.7%** (from 10.38/1k down to 6.67/1k for respiratory care). Adjusting for group-quarters residents exposes underlying non-student health trends.
* **Care Routing Recommendation:** Directing Medicaid ACO intervention funds toward primary care walk-in capacity and community health worker deployment in Olneyville provides the highest return on emergency room diversion.
:::

# Methodology & Data Lineage

## Row

::: {.card title="Data Sources & Methodological Perimeter"}
### Data Lineage
* **RIDOH Hospital Discharge Program:** [State Emergency Department Summaries](https://health.ri.gov/data/hospital-discharge-data)
* **US Census ACS 5-Year Estimates:** [ZCTA Demographics & Group Quarters](https://data.census.gov/)
* **CMS NPPES Registry:** [Geocoded Providence FQHC Directory](https://npiregistry.cms.hhs.gov/)

### Methodological Perimeter
1. **Group-Quarters Student Normalization:** Calculated as $Pop_{community} = Pop_{total} - Pop_{group\_quarters}$ to isolate permanent non-student community baselines.
2. **Dataset Boundaries:** Captures **hospital-based acute care visits only**. Independent urgent care walk-in clinics, campus student health centers (e.g., Brown University Health Services), and out-of-state hospital visits are excluded.
:::
